SELECT json_build_object(
  'max_connections', current_setting('max_connections')::int,
  'superuser_reserved_connections', current_setting('superuser_reserved_connections')::int,
  'reserved_connections', coalesce(current_setting('reserved_connections', true), '0')::int,
  'client_backends', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend'),
  'groups', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(g ORDER BY g.n DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT a.application_name, a.usename, host(a.client_addr) AS client_addr, count(*) AS n,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state = 'active') AS active,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state = 'idle') AS idle,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state LIKE 'idle in transaction%') AS idle_in_tx,
             bool_or(r.rolsuper) AS superuser
      FROM pg_stat_activity a LEFT JOIN pg_roles r ON r.rolname = a.usename
      WHERE a.backend_type = 'client backend'
      GROUP BY a.application_name, a.usename, host(a.client_addr)) g))

exec_create: psql -U exchange -d exchange -X -q -t -A -c 
SELECT json_build_object(
  'ts', to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),
  'lock_waiters', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = 'exchange' AND wait_event_type = 'Lock'),
  'balance_rows', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('pid', t.pid, 'kind', t.kind, 'waited_ms', t.waited_ms)),
                                   '[]'::json) FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.pid) l.pid, coalesce(ac.owner_type || ':' || ac.purpose, 'unknown') AS kind,
               floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM clock_timestamp() - a.query_start) * 1000) AS waited_ms
          FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON a.pid = l.pid
          LEFT JOIN balances b ON b.ctid = format('(%s,%s)', l.page, l.tuple)::tid
          LEFT JOIN accounts ac ON ac.id = b.account_id
         WHERE l.locktype = 'tuple' AND l.relation = 'balances'::regclass AND a.wait_event_type = 'Lock'
         ORDER BY l.pid) t))

  'max_connections', current_setting('max_connections')::int,
  'superuser_reserved_connections', current_setting('superuser_reserved_connections')::int,
  'reserved_connections', coalesce(current_setting('reserved_connections', true), '0')::int,
  'client_backends', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend'),
  'groups', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(g ORDER BY g.n DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT a.application_name, a.usename, host(a.client_addr) AS client_addr, count(*) AS n,

             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state = 'idle') AS idle,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state LIKE 'idle in transaction%') AS idle_in_tx,
             bool_or(r.rolsuper) AS superuser
      FROM pg_stat_activity a LEFT JOIN pg_roles r ON r.rolname = a.usename
      WHERE a.backend_type = 'client backend'
      GROUP BY a.application_name, a.usename, host(a.client_addr)) g))

exec_create: psql -U exchange -d exchange -X -q -t -A -c 
SELECT json_build_object(
  'max_connections', current_setting('max_connections')::int,
  'superuser_reserved_connections', current_setting('superuser_reserved_connections')::int,
  'reserved_connections', coalesce(current_setting('reserved_connections', true), '0')::int,
  'client_backends', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend'),
  'groups', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(g ORDER BY g.n DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT a.application_name, a.usename, host(a.client_addr) AS client_addr, count(*) AS n,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state = 'active') AS active,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state = 'idle') AS idle,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state LIKE 'idle in transaction%') AS idle_in_tx,
             bool_or(r.rolsuper) AS superuser
      FROM pg_stat_activity a LEFT JOIN pg_roles r ON r.rolname = a.usename
      WHERE a.backend_type = 'client backend'
      GROUP BY a.application_name, a.usename, host(a.client_addr)) g))

      GROUP BY a.application_name, a.usename, host(a.client_addr)) g))

exec_create: psql -U exchange -d exchange -X -q -t -A -c SELECT coalesce(json_object_agg(e, n), '{}'::json) FROM (SELECT e, (SELECT count(*) FROM command_journal WHERE fencing_token = e) + (SELECT count(*) FROM event_journal WHERE fencing_epoch = e) + (SELECT count(*) FROM trades WHERE fencing_epoch = e) + (SELECT count(*) FROM snapshots WHERE fencing_epoch = e) AS n FROM unnest(ARRAY[9,10]::bigint[]) AS e) x

exec_create: psql -U exchange -d exchange -X -q -t -A -c 
SELECT json_build_object(
  'ts', to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),
  'lock_waiters', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = 'exchange' AND wait_event_type = 'Lock'),
  'balance_rows', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('pid', t.pid, 'kind', t.kind, 'waited_ms', t.waited_ms)),
                                   '[]'::json) FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.pid) l.pid, coalesce(ac.owner_type || ':' || ac.purpose, 'unknown') AS kind,
               floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM clock_timestamp() - a.query_start) * 1000) AS waited_ms
          FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON a.pid = l.pid
          LEFT JOIN balances b ON b.ctid = format('(%s,%s)', l.page, l.tuple)::tid
          LEFT JOIN accounts ac ON ac.id = b.account_id
         WHERE l.locktype = 'tuple' AND l.relation = 'balances'::regclass AND a.wait_event_type = 'Lock'
         ORDER BY l.pid) t))

  'groups', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(g ORDER BY g.n DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (

             bool_or(r.rolsuper) AS superuser
      FROM pg_stat_activity a LEFT JOIN pg_roles r ON r.rolname = a.usename
      WHERE a.backend_type = 'client backend'
      GROUP BY a.application_name, a.usename, host(a.client_addr)) g))

  'max_connections', current_setting('max_connections')::int,
  'superuser_reserved_connections', current_setting('superuser_reserved_connections')::int,
  'reserved_connections', coalesce(current_setting('reserved_connections', true), '0')::int,
  'client_backends', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend'),
  'groups', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(g ORDER BY g.n DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT a.application_name, a.usename, host(a.client_addr) AS client_addr, count(*) AS n,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state = 'active') AS active,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state = 'idle') AS idle,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state LIKE 'idle in transaction%') AS idle_in_tx,
             bool_or(r.rolsuper) AS superuser
      FROM pg_stat_activity a LEFT JOIN pg_roles r ON r.rolname = a.usename
      WHERE a.backend_type = 'client backend'
      GROUP BY a.application_name, a.usename, host(a.client_addr)) g))

exec_create: psql -U exchange -d exchange -X -q -t -A -c 
SELECT json_build_object(
  'ts', to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),
  'lock_waiters', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = 'exchange' AND wait_event_type = 'Lock'),
  'balance_rows', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('pid', t.pid, 'kind', t.kind, 'waited_ms', t.waited_ms)),
                                   '[]'::json) FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.pid) l.pid, coalesce(ac.owner_type || ':' || ac.purpose, 'unknown') AS kind,
               floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM clock_timestamp() - a.query_start) * 1000) AS waited_ms
          FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON a.pid = l.pid
          LEFT JOIN balances b ON b.ctid = format('(%s,%s)', l.page, l.tuple)::tid
          LEFT JOIN accounts ac ON ac.id = b.account_id
         WHERE l.locktype = 'tuple' AND l.relation = 'balances'::regclass AND a.wait_event_type = 'Lock'
         ORDER BY l.pid) t))

SELECT json_build_object(
  'max_connections', current_setting('max_connections')::int,
  'superuser_reserved_connections', current_setting('superuser_reserved_connections')::int,
  'reserved_connections', coalesce(current_setting('reserved_connections', true), '0')::int,
  'client_backends', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend'),
  'groups', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(g ORDER BY g.n DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT a.application_name, a.usename, host(a.client_addr) AS client_addr, count(*) AS n,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state = 'active') AS active,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state = 'idle') AS idle,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state LIKE 'idle in transaction%') AS idle_in_tx,
             bool_or(r.rolsuper) AS superuser
      FROM pg_stat_activity a LEFT JOIN pg_roles r ON r.rolname = a.usename
      WHERE a.backend_type = 'client backend'
      GROUP BY a.application_name, a.usename, host(a.client_addr)) g))

  'balance_rows', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('pid', t.pid, 'kind', t.kind, 'waited_ms', t.waited_ms)),
                                   '[]'::json) FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.pid) l.pid, coalesce(ac.owner_type || ':' || ac.purpose, 'unknown') AS kind,

          FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON a.pid = l.pid

          LEFT JOIN accounts ac ON ac.id = b.account_id
         WHERE l.locktype = 'tuple' AND l.relation = 'balances'::regclass AND a.wait_event_type = 'Lock'
         ORDER BY l.pid) t))

exec_create: psql -U exchange -d exchange -X -q -t -A -c 
SELECT json_build_object(
  'ts', to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),
  'lock_waiters', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname = 'exchange' AND wait_event_type = 'Lock'),
  'balance_rows', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('pid', t.pid, 'kind', t.kind, 'waited_ms', t.waited_ms)),
                                   '[]'::json) FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.pid) l.pid, coalesce(ac.owner_type || ':' || ac.purpose, 'unknown') AS kind,
               floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM clock_timestamp() - a.query_start) * 1000) AS waited_ms
          FROM pg_locks l JOIN pg_stat_activity a ON a.pid = l.pid
          LEFT JOIN balances b ON b.ctid = format('(%s,%s)', l.page, l.tuple)::tid
          LEFT JOIN accounts ac ON ac.id = b.account_id
         WHERE l.locktype = 'tuple' AND l.relation = 'balances'::regclass AND a.wait_event_type = 'Lock'
         ORDER BY l.pid) t))

exec_create: psql -U exchange -d exchange -X -q -t -A -c 
SELECT json_build_object(
  'max_connections', current_setting('max_connections')::int,
  'superuser_reserved_connections', current_setting('superuser_reserved_connections')::int,
  'reserved_connections', coalesce(current_setting('reserved_connections', true), '0')::int,
  'client_backends', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend'),
  'groups', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(g ORDER BY g.n DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT a.application_name, a.usename, host(a.client_addr) AS client_addr, count(*) AS n,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state = 'active') AS active,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state = 'idle') AS idle,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state LIKE 'idle in transaction%') AS idle_in_tx,
             bool_or(r.rolsuper) AS superuser
      FROM pg_stat_activity a LEFT JOIN pg_roles r ON r.rolname = a.usename
      WHERE a.backend_type = 'client backend'
      GROUP BY a.application_name, a.usename, host(a.client_addr)) g))

  'client_backends', (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend'),
  'groups', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(g ORDER BY g.n DESC), '[]'::json) FROM (
      SELECT a.application_name, a.usename, host(a.client_addr) AS client_addr, count(*) AS n,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.state = 'active') AS active,

Ubuntu is a Debian-based Linux operating system that runs from the desktop to the cloud, to all your internet connected things.
It is the world's most popular operating system across public clouds and OpenStack clouds.
It is the number one platform for containers; from Docker to Kubernetes to LXD, Ubuntu can run your containers at scale.
Fast, secure and simple, Ubuntu powers millions of PCs worldwide.
